## 1. Architectural Mission
module_id: "mod_security_cloud_posture_and_compliance"

## 2. Invariant Checklist
- **Automated Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)**: Real-time drift detection and policy-as-code audits against the CIS Cloud Benchmarks, Kubernetes Pod Security Standards (`Restricted` baseline), and automated IAM least-privilege analysis.
- **KMS Hardware Envelope Encryption (FIPS 140-3 Level 3)**: Envelope encryption strategy utilizing cloud Hardware Security Modules (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault). Master Keys (CMKs) never leave hardware boundaries; transient Data Encryption Keys (DEKs) are generated, utilized in memory, and cryptographically zeroized (`zeroize` Rust trait).
- **Immutable Cloud WORM Vault Egress (SEC Rule 17a-4 / FINRA Rule 4511)**: Continuous streaming mirroring of all cryptographic Merkle ledger blocks and audit events to Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) storage with strict Legal Hold and Compliance Lock flags preventing truncation or deletion even by cloud account root credentials.
- **End-to-End Compliance Mapping**: Programmatically maps platform controls to SOC2 Type II (Trust Services Criteria), ISO/IEC 27001:2022, GDPR Article 32, HIPAA Security Rule, and PCI DSS v4.0.
